title: 1975 Kind of Lovin'
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You reach across the table,
I almost pull away.
Then leave my hand beneath yours
And run clean out of things to say.
I've been somebody's favourite
Till somebody else came by.
Now you're looking at me different,
And I want to tell you why.
[Chorus]
I'm afraid of love
Unless it's that nineteen seventy-five kind of lovin'.
Your favourite record on,
Bare feet dancing in the kitchen.
All or nothing, baby,
That's the only way I fall.
I want that stay-and-work-it-out love,
Or I don't want love at all.
[Verse 2]
Dad still keeps her folded letter
In the pocket of his coat.
Forty years of rain and washing,
He still knows each word she wrote.
They had nights they weren't speaking,
But they learned to talk again.
That's the kind of love I'm wanting
When you reach out for my hand.
[Chorus]
I'm afraid of love
Unless it's that nineteen seventy-five kind of lovin'.
Your favourite record on,
Bare feet dancing in the kitchen.
All or nothing, baby,
That's the only way I fall.
I want that stay-and-work-it-out love,
Or I don't want love at all.
[Bridge]
I don't need a different decade,
Just somebody who means stay.
And I can't ask you for forever
While I'm halfway turned away.
So I lace my fingers through yours.
Let me meet you all the way.
[Final Chorus]
I'm afraid of love,
But I want that nineteen seventy-five kind of lovin'.
Put your favourite record on,
Let's go dancing in the kitchen.
All or nothing, baby,
Here's my heart, I'm risking all.
Give me that stay-and-work-it-out love,
And I'll catch you when you fall.
[Outro]
I'm still afraid of love.
But I ain't pulling back my hand.

title: 5 Love Languages
lyrics:
[INTRO — Instantly addictive five-note piano and guitar melody]
[Warm female vocal, intimate and playful]
Say it...
Show it...
Stay with me...
Oh, love me in five languages.


[Deep rolling bass and infectious Afro-house drums enter]


[VERSE 1 — Soulful female vocals]
You say I'm beautiful when I don't feel it
See the best in me when I can't see it
Three little words in a crowded room
Still sound different coming from you


You make me coffee when the day gets heavy
Take my hand when my heart ain't steady
Never needed diamonds or a perfect plan
Just someone who could understand


[PRE-CHORUS — Rising piano chords]
Some people talk, some people show
Some hold tight, some take it slow
But every little thing you do
Keeps leading me right back to you


[CHORUS — Huge, euphoric, unforgettable]
Love me in five languages
Five ways, one heartbeat
Every little thing you do
Makes the world move under me


Say it, show it, stay with me
Bring me flowers, dance with me
Hold me close until the morning light
Love me in five languages tonight!


[POST-CHORUS — Catchy female vocal chant]
Oh-oh-oh, love me, love me!
Oh-oh-oh, five ways, one heartbeat!
Oh-oh-oh, love me, love me!
Every way you love me feels like home!


[BUILD — Signature five-note melody, rising percussion]
Say it...
Show it...
Stay...
Hold me...
Love me!


[ONE BEAT SILENCE]


[DROP 1 — EXPLOSIVE IBIZA MELODIC HOUSE]
[Massive punchy kick and deep rolling bass]
[Signature five-note piano melody explodes]
[Bright rhythmic electric guitar and Afro-house percussion]
[Warm tenor saxophone answers the piano hook]
[Infectious syncopated drums and claps]
[Extended euphoric instrumental — no lead singing]
[Rhythmic variations and soaring melodic counterpoint]


[VERSE 2 — Playful female vocal with soulful male responses]
[Female]
You leave a little note beside my pillow
Bring me wildflowers just because
You give me all your Sunday mornings
When the whole world asks too much


[Male]
I'll find the time when time is missing
I'll hear the words you never say
And if the night gets cold around us
I'll pull you close and let you stay


[PRE-CHORUS — Male and female harmonies]
[Female]
Don't need the moon, don't need the stars


[Male]
I'll meet you right where you are


[Both]
A thousand ways to say it's true
But every road leads back to you


[CHORUS — Powerful male-female duet]
Love me in five languages
Five ways, one heartbeat
Every little thing you do
Makes the world move under me


Say it, show it, stay with me
Bring me flowers, dance with me
Hold me close until the morning light
Love me in five languages tonight!


[DROP 2 — GUITAR AND SAXOPHONE GROOVE]
[Signature piano hook with live saxophone harmony]
[Driving Afro-house drums, elastic bass]
[Electric guitar plays an infectious syncopated riff]
[Extended instrumental dancefloor groove]


[BREAKDOWN — Emotional piano, no drums]
[Female — intimate, vulnerable]
When we're old and the music's faded
When the photographs have lost their shine
Will you still reach across the table
And put your hand inside of mine?


[Male — soft and reassuring]
I'll tell you every morning
I'll show you every day
I'll find a thousand little reasons
To love you in a thousand ways


[Both — growing harmonies]
And if the whole world falls apart
We'll still be speaking heart to heart


[FINAL BUILD — Gradually rising percussion]
[Female]
Say it!


[Male]
I'll tell you!


[Female]
Show it!


[Male]
I'll prove it!


[Female]
Stay with me!


[Male]
Forever!


[Both]
ONE LOVE!
FIVE LANGUAGES!


[ONE BEAT COMPLETE SILENCE]


[FINAL DROP — MAXIMUM IBIZA EUPHORIA]
[Explosive full house drums and thunderous tom fills]
[Signature five-note piano melody returns]
[Soaring live saxophone and bright electric guitar]
[Huge emotional chord progression and uplifting vocal harmonies]
[Deep rolling bass, congas, claps and driving percussion]
[Extended euphoric instrumental dancefloor climax]
[Fresh counter-melody and powerful drum fills]


[GROUP VOCAL CHANTS]
Five ways!
One heartbeat!
Say it, show it!
Love me, love me!


[FINAL CHORUS — Euphoric male-female duet]
Love me in five languages
Five ways, one heartbeat
Every little thing you do
Makes the world move under me


Say it, show it, stay with me
Bring me flowers, dance with me
Hold me close until the morning light
Love me in five languages tonight!


[OUTRO — DJ-friendly rolling drums]
[Piano plays the unforgettable five-note signature]
[Warm saxophone answers softly]


[Female whisper]
Five love languages...


[Male whisper]
One heartbeat...


[Both]
You and me.


[END]

title: After I Win
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I sleep where the streetlights hum all night
Blueprints folded underneath my coat
Got ideas that could change somebody's life
But nobody listens to a man with no home
You see the shoes before the schematics
See the beard before the mind
You don't ask if the idea could work
You look around
to see who liked it first.
[Pre-Chorus]
You say you think for yourself
So why do numbers on a screen
decide who deserves your help?
[Chorus]
You don't help me win
You love me after I win
You won't open the door
Till somebody already let me in
Three likes — keep scrolling
Three million — now it's gold
You call yourselves leaders
But you go where the sheep already go
You don't believe in people
You believe in people
after they win
[Verse 2]
Your brother starts a business
You don't even answer him
Some celebrity posts a picture
You reply before the screen goes dim
Your daughter writes a book
It gathers dust beside your chair
Your friend becomes a trainer
You joke like she should stay where she was
But let the whole world love them
Suddenly
you're proud you knew them first.
[Chorus]
You don't help me win
You love me after I win
You won't open the door
Till somebody already let me in
Three likes — keep scrolling
Three million — now it's gold
You call yourselves leaders
But you go where the sheep already go
You don't believe in people
You believe in people
after they win
[Verse 3 — rhythmic]
Then I found a phone
Made a few fake names
Posted the same invention
Played your little game
One account said “genius”
Another one hit share
Same people who ignored me yesterday
Suddenly stopped
and stared
Same man
Same mind
Same invention
Nothing changed
Except now
you saw a crowd.
[Bridge]
I'm not asking for a handout
Give me one chance
I'll give you a thousand back
Give me freedom
I'll give you inventions
Give me resources
I'll give you solutions
Help me
so I can help you
a million times more
That's all I ever asked for.
[Final Chorus]
You don't help me win
You love me after I win
You won't build the bridge
But you'll cheer when I cross it
You'll ignore the little workshop
Then photograph the office
You'll buy garbage from a millionaire
Before you back your own
Then swear you're not a sheep
While waiting
for the sheep to go.
I never asked you to save me
I asked you to believe
before I win.
[Outro]
Same man.
Same mind.
Same invention.
Three likes?
Crazy.
Three million?
Genius.
Nothing changed.
Except the sheep moved.

title: After Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Don't leave my coffee cup beside the sink
Like moving it would mean you loved me less
Don't save my side of every room for me
As if an empty space could keep me here
The life we made was never in those things
It was your hand reaching for mine in sleep
So when this house gets quieter
Than you can stand
Promise me
[Pre-Chorus]
When the silence says that moving on is wrong
Remember loving me means going on
[Chorus]
I want you dancing in the kitchen
I want you laughing way too loud
I want somebody else to learn
How you take your coffee now
Don't let our forever be the reason
You forget what living means
If you want to keep on loving me
Love your life after me
[Verse 2]
We spent our best years thinking they were small
Keys on the counter, pictures down the hall
You stole the covers, I forgot the milk
We danced by the stove when the whole house went dark
Funny how forever looked so ordinary then
I'd hold each Tuesday like it wouldn't come again
And that's why I can't bear the thought of you
Spending yours with ghosts
[Pre-Chorus]
You don't betray me when your heart moves on
You only lose me if you stop because I'm gone
[Chorus]
I want you dancing in the kitchen
I want you laughing way too loud
I want somebody else to learn
How you take your coffee now
Don't let our forever be the reason
You forget what living means
If you want to keep on loving me
Love your life after me
[Bridge]
If my memory ever begs you not to change
That's not me
That's grief wearing my face
I loved you far too much
To make my love a cage
So open every window
Let the morning in
And don't you dare apologize
For being happy again
[Final Chorus]
Go dancing in that kitchen
Throw the windows open wide
Put the coffee on for morning
Let the whole world back inside
Don't call it leaving me behind
When you go where I can't be
You won't love me any less
By loving life after me
Love your life
[Outro]
Someday you'll make one cup
You won't even mean to
You'll open up the window
And morning will come through

title: After Midnight
lyrics:
[Intro]
Yeah…
Come a little closer
Don't say nothing
I already know what you're thinking tonight
[Verse 1]
Red lipstick on the rim of your glass
Low light dancing while the whole world fades back
You walk in slow like you know what you do
And every little move got me watching you
Your perfume hanging in the air like a secret
Your eyes say more than your lips ever speak it
You lean in close, and the room disappears
I can feel your heartbeat getting closer to mine, my dear
[Pre-Chorus]
So leave your worries at the door
We don't need them anymore
Let the music fall away
I wanna memorize you this way
[Chorus]
Come closer, closer
Let me get lost in you
Slow motion, no words
Baby, let me feel the truth
Your eyes, your smile
That little way you pull me in
If tonight is a dream
Don't wake me up again
Come closer, closer
Till there's nowhere left to hide
Your heartbeat, my heartbeat
Moving perfectly in time
Girl, the moon can wait
Let the whole world disappear
I don't want tomorrow
I just want you right here
[Verse 2]
You put your hand in mine like you're making a promise
That kind of touch makes a man lose his logic
You whisper my name and I swear that it changes
Every little second, every breath that we're taking
Your silhouette underneath the bedroom light
Got me thinking 'bout you for the rest of my life
No rush, baby, let the moment unfold
Some things feel better when they're never told
[Pre-Chorus]
So leave your worries at the door
We don't need them anymore
Let the music fall away
I wanna memorize you this way
[Chorus]
Come closer, closer
Let me get lost in you
Slow motion, no words
Baby, let me feel the truth
Your eyes, your smile
That little way you pull me in
If tonight is a dream
Don't wake me up again
Come closer, closer
Till there's nowhere left to hide
Your heartbeat, my heartbeat
Moving perfectly in time
Girl, the moon can wait
Let the whole world disappear
I don't want tomorrow
I just want you right here
[Bridge]
If I could stop the clock
I'd stop it right here
With your head on my shoulder
And your lips by my ear
No cameras, no phones
No outside noise
Just you looking at me
Like I'm still your choice
And if you ask me
What I want tonight
It's not the stars
It's not the city lights
It's you…
Just you…
[Final Chorus]
Come closer, closer
Let me get lost in you
Slow motion, no words
Baby, let me feel the truth
Your eyes, your smile
That little way you pull me in
If tonight is a dream
Don't wake me up again
Come closer, closer
Till the sunrise finds our room
Let the morning wait
We've got nothing left to prove
Your heartbeat, my heartbeat
Like a song we always knew
If the night never ends
I'll spend forever here with you
[Outro]
Come closer…
A little closer…
Don't say a word…
I already know.
It's you.
It's always been you.

title: All the Ordinary Days
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Your shoes are underneath my chair,
Your coat is hanging next to mine.
You ask if I need anything
Before you leave at half past nine.
I catch your hand and pull you close.
These are the things I'd miss the most.
[Chorus]
Give me all the ordinary days,
Your sleepy voice across the hall.
Your Sunday singing in the kitchen,
Your name lighting up when you call.
When the flowers leave the table,
When the last song fades away,
I want you beside me
Through all the ordinary days.
[Verse 2]
Last Sunday, we both said too much.
You went outside; I stayed awake.
I found you sitting on the steps
And owned the hurt I'd tried to shake.
We talked until the sky turned blue.
I learned to listen more to you.
[Chorus]
Give me all the ordinary days,
Your sleepy voice across the hall.
Your Sunday singing in the kitchen,
Your name lighting up when you call.
When the flowers leave the table,
When the last song fades away,
I want you beside me
Through all the ordinary days.
[Bridge]
Tomorrow, when they ask me,
I'll say the words out loud.
But I've been saying yes to you
Without a ring or crowd.
When you ask, "Will you still want this
When there's nothing to celebrate?"
[Final Chorus]
Give me all the ordinary days,
Your sleepy voice across the hall.
Your Sunday singing in the kitchen,
Your name lighting up when you call.
When the flowers leave the table,
When the last song fades away,
I'll keep choosing you, my darling,
Through all the ordinary days.
[Outro]
All my days,
All my days.
Your shoes are underneath my chair.
I leave them there.

title: Ask Me Again
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I typed, "I hope you're doing well,"
Then watched the cursor blink.
There's more I ought to say to you
Than asking how you've been.
You asked me out last Friday.
I let my fear say no.
[Chorus]
Ask me again,
If you still want to.
I had a yes
I couldn't get through.
I let an old goodbye
Tell me what to do.
Ask me again.
I'd like to go with you.
[Verse 2]
You didn't try to change my mind
Or make me feel unkind.
You said, "I understand," and smiled.
I've thought about that all week.
Tonight I wrote, "I wanted to."
Then let you read the truth.
[Chorus]
Ask me again,
If you still want to.
I had a yes
I couldn't get through.
I let an old goodbye
Tell me what to do.
Ask me again.
I'd like to go with you.
[Bridge]
Then I thought, you've done the asking.
It's my turn to take that chance.
There's a band in town on Friday.
Would you save me one slow dance?
[Final Chorus]
I'm asking now,
If you still want to.
I've got a yes
I'm finally saying to you.
That same old goodbye
Don't get to choose for me.
I'm asking now.
Would you go out with me?
[Outro]
I almost wrote, "Forget I asked."
Instead, I sent you Friday's plans.

title: Be Brave
lyrics:
Verse 1

The mirror keeps no secrets—
it only shows the man you made.
Not the man you say you are,
but the one your choices name.

A little boy is watching
how you carry being strong,
how you speak when you are angry,
what you do when you are wrong.

And the woman standing near you
should never learn to fear
the hands that promised love to her,
or the voice she once held dear.

Pre-Chorus

Strength is not a harder heart.
It isn't hiding every scar.
Sometimes strength is stopping pain
from travelling where you are.

Chorus

Be brave.
Be brave enough to dream.
Be brave.
Be better than you've been.

Be brave enough to carry
the burden that you bear
without laying it on someone
who was never meant to wear it.

Be brave.
When truth is hard to face.
Be brave.
When love demands a change.

If you dream of a better world,
don't wait for one to come.

Be brave enough to become one.

Verse 2

A woman shouldn't have to wonder
which man walks through the door.
A child should never read your footsteps
like they've heard that storm before.

You can blame the men before you.
You can say, “That's how I learned.”
But pain is not an inheritance
another heart must earn.

And when another man calls cruelty
the proof that he is strong,
don't laugh because it's easier.

Be brave enough to say he's wrong.

Pre-Chorus

You can carry what they gave you
without giving it away.

You can be the place the hurting
finally ends today.

Chorus

Be brave.
Be brave enough to dream.
Be brave.
Be better than you've been.

Be brave enough to carry
the burden that you bear
without turning love to fear
for the people in your care.

Be brave.
When pride says, “Never bend.”
Be brave.
Say, “I was wrong”—and mean it then.

If you dream of a better world,

let the better world begin
with you.

Bridge

Now stand before the mirror.

No crowd.
No blame.
No place to hide.

Look that man straight in the eyes
and ask what he leaves behind.

If your anger made her smaller—

own it.

If your words became her fear—

own it.

If a child learned how to tremble
when your footsteps came too near—

own it.

Don't call shame accountability.
Don't turn guilt into escape.

The bravest thing a man can do
is face the hurt he helped create.

Say:

I did it.
I was wrong.
I will listen.
I will change.

Then prove those words tomorrow
when the easy promise fades.

Because sorry isn't courage
if the hurting stays the same.

And love is not what you promise.

Love is what becomes safe.

Final Chorus

BE BRAVE.

Be brave enough to dream
of boys who grow to men
who never need to prove their strength
by frightening someone else again.

BE BRAVE.

For every woman who deserves
to walk through her own door
and know the man who says he loves her
will make her fear no more.

BE BRAVE.

For every little child
who deserves to understand
that love is never something
they should fear inside a man.

BE BRAVE.

When your brother needs the truth.
BE BRAVE.
And help him find it too.

If we dream of a better world,
then dreaming isn't enough.

Look into the mirror.

Face the man you've become.

And if tomorrow needs a better man—

be brave enough
to be one.

Outro

Maybe the better world begins
without thunder from above.

Maybe it begins the day
a man decides that strength is love.

And somewhere years from now,
a child will grow up unafraid—

because one man carried his pain

and was brave enough

not to give it away.

title: Blue Eyed Samurai Dragon
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
First time you saw me, I was bleeding
Red running off my hands
Three men down and one still crawling
Nobody dared to stand
I had a face they learned to fear
A heart I kept behind
But you walked straight through all that darkness
Like darkness had gone blind
[Pre-Chorus]
They saw teeth
You saw scars
They saw hell behind my eyes
You stood there dressed in white
Like heaven wasn't scared to die
[Chorus]
I'm your Blue Eyed Samurai Dragon
Fire breathing through my veins
You're the angel in the wreckage
Standing barefoot in the flames
I'm the thunder, you're the silence
I'm the wound and you're the grace
I'm your Blue Eyed Samurai Dragon
You're the light I couldn't chase
[Verse 2]
I was raised by empty highways
Cold rooms and closing doors
Learned that mercy gets you wounded
So I quit believing in yours
Every town added to the story
Every scar became a name
Till the man beneath the monster
And the monster looked the same
Then you laid your hand against me
Where nobody ever would
Said, “I know what you're capable of—
I'm asking if you're good.”
[Pre-Chorus 2]
They saw blood
You saw pain
They saw something born to fight
I was everything gone wrong
You were everything gone right
[Chorus]
I'm your Blue Eyed Samurai Dragon
Fire breathing through my veins
You're the angel in the wreckage
Standing barefoot in the flames
I'm the thunder, you're the silence
I'm the wound and you're the grace
I'm your Blue Eyed Samurai Dragon
You're the light I couldn't chase
[Bridge — stripped, almost spoken]
I don't know why heaven sent you
To a creature built like me
Maybe angels need a darkness
So we know what light can be
Maybe monsters need an angel
Who won't run when they get close
Someone strong enough to touch them
Where it hurts the fucking most
You never asked me not to be dangerous
Never asked me to grow wings
You just taught this goddamn dragon
There are things worth guarding
[Final Chorus]
I'm still your Blue Eyed Samurai Dragon
Still got fire in my veins
But now I burn for something different
Now my fury has a name
You're the mercy to my madness
You're the calm inside my rage
I'm the monster at your doorway
You're the angel that remains
Let the whole damn world come hunting
Let them curse me, let them pray
I'll be your Blue Eyed Samurai Dragon
If you'll be my saving grace
[Outro]
Black and white
Fire and wings
Two broken halves
Of different things
You kiss the monster
I guard the angel
And somehow...
We make one.

title: Brave Enough To Love Again
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You still reach for my hand before you wake
Still know when I’m hurting by the face I make
We were young, broke, driving nowhere all night
Your feet on the dash in the radio light
We danced in the rain, drank cheap red wine
Watched the same moon through thousands of different skies
And somewhere between all your laughter and mine
I knew I’d found the love of my life
[Pre-Chorus]
Every road
Every scar
Every dream that fell apart
I’d live it all again
Just to end up where you are
[Chorus]
You’re my everything
So if I go first
Don’t let loving me
Make the rest of your life hurt
Play our old song
Climb that mountain
Look at those stars like we did back then
You’re my everything
But when I’m gone
Be brave enough to love again
[Verse 2]
We counted loose change when the rent ran late
Slammed a few doors, learned how to forgive mistakes
Sat in the driveway when the doctor called
Your hand found mine when the words wouldn’t come at all
We buried our people, watched good dreams disappear
Held each other closer through the hardest years
And every time this life brought us to our knees
You carried me, or I carried you back to our feet
[Pre-Chorus]
Every tear
Every fall
We never faced one alone
That’s what makes this one
The hardest one I’ve known
[Chorus]
You’re my everything
So when I go first
Don’t let my goodbye
Turn your whole world into hurt
Dance in the rain
Pour that red wine
Let yourself laugh like you did back then
You’re my everything
But when I’m gone
Be brave enough to love again
[Bridge]
We survived every storm together
But mine is the one you’ll face alone
And the hardest part of dying
Is knowing I can’t help you carry it home
So don’t love me by staying lonely
Don’t wear your sorrow like a ring
You were the love of my whole life
Don’t let me be the last love you ever see
If another hand finds yours someday
Please don’t pull away for me
The heart I loved was made for loving
Not for living in a memory
[Final Chorus]
You’re my everything
And you always will be
But your forever doesn’t have to end with me
So if love finds you
Open your heart
Don’t let guilt steal one beautiful beat
Play our old song
Climb that mountain
Stand beneath those stars again
And if somebody’s standing beside you
Be brave enough to love again
[Outro]
Same stars
Same moon
Same beautiful view
A different hand
Holding on to you
And if you’re smiling
Under that sky
Then loving you
Was worth goodbye

title: Careless Hearts, Endless Nights
lyrics:
[INTRO — INSTANT SIGNATURE HOOK]
[Four-note muted electric guitar riff starts on beat one]
[Bright piano answers, warm disco bass and crisp house drums enter]
[Breathy female vocal]


Careless hearts...
Endless nights...
Oh-oh-oh...


[VERSE 1 — Warm, intimate female vocals]
The last train left, the pavement shone
We found a party carrying on
You took my hand and said, "Come see"
The night still had a place for me


No big plans, no grand escape
Just little sparks we couldn't name
I came in tired of getting by
You made me feel a little wild


[PRE-CHORUS — Rising piano, emotional vocal]
And every stranger sang along
To words we'd never heard before
Your hand went up, I closed my eyes
And something in me came alive


[CHORUS — HUGE, JOYFUL, ADDICTIVE MELODY]
Careless hearts, endless nights
We got lost and called it life
One more song before daylight
Careless hearts, endless nights


Oh-oh-oh, hold on tight
Oh-oh-oh, don't say goodbye
If the sunrise comes to find us
Let it find us side by side


Careless hearts!
Endless nights!


[BUILD — Piano chords, rising drums, repeating guitar hook]
[Female whisper]
We got lost...

[DROP 1 — EXPLOSIVE IBIZA PIANO HOUSE]

[Crisp claps, congas and energetic drum fills]
[Wordless chopped female vocal answers the guitar]
[Extended instrumental — no lead singing]

title: Dream It True
lyrics:
Verse 1

The mirror held my face this morning,

under everything we fear,
I heard one question rise between us:

I can see myself in you.

I can't turn my back on you.

Take the world we keep on wishing for
and dream it true.

Verse 2

held his umbrella wide

I can't turn my back on you.

We don't have to wait on heaven—
love has work for us to do.
Take the world we keep on wishing for
and dream it true.

Bridge

I kept waiting for a better Man,
for a hero, for a sign—
then the mirror spoke my name and asked,
“What will you do with your time?”

I can't heal every sorrow.
I can't make the whole world new.
But I can leave more love behind me
than the fear I ever knew.

And if you do the same beside me,
and another does it too,
maybe all the world is waiting
for what ordinary hearts can do.

Final Chorus

Dream it true—dream it true!
Let tomorrow start with what we do.
Every hand can be a shelter,
every heart can make room too.

We don't have to wait on heaven—
love has work for us to do.
Let the frightened find their courage,
let the lonely make it through.

For every child who's still believing,
for every soul still reaching through,
take the world we've only dreamed of—

and dream it true.

Dream it true!

Till no one has to stand alone.
Till every stranger can come home.
Till mercy speaks louder than fear ever knew—

Dream it true.

Outro

And one day may a child look in the mirror
and never wish the world were new.

May the dream we carried for them
be the world they wake up to.

title: I Decide
lyrics:
Verse 1

They taught me to knock softly
on doors with my name on them,
to wait outside and call it grace,
then smile and ask again.

I learned to lower my laughter
when the room got too still,
turn “I want” into “maybe,”
turn “I can” into “if you will.”

I spent years reading faces,
trying not to take too much—

till I finally asked myself:

Who taught me I needed their permission
to become who I already was?

Pre-Chorus

I don't need another green light.
I don't need another sign.

This heart, this voice, this one life—

they're mine.

Chorus

Who tells me who I'm gonna be?
I decide.

Who tells me how high I can reach?
I decide.

I won't make myself smaller
just to fit somebody's life.

If the door has got my name on it,

I'm walking through tonight.

What I want.
What I'm worth.
Where I'm going with this life—

I decide.

Verse 2

I've cried in bathroom mirrors,
then walked back in composed.

I've smiled while being talked across
by someone who knew less than I know.

I've stayed where love meant shrinking.
I've said sorry just for breathing.

Then one night I turned a handle

and learned that leaving
can be freedom.

Now the scars don't make me weaker.
They remind me I survived.

Every time somebody dimmed me,

something brighter stayed alive.

Pre-Chorus 2

I don't need to be fearless
to finally be brave.

Sometimes courage is a shaking hand

that turns the handle anyway.

Chorus

Who tells me who I'm gonna be?
I decide.

Who tells me what I'm allowed to dream?
I decide.

I won't make myself smaller.
I won't apologize for my light.

If the door has got my name on it,

I'm walking through tonight.

What I love.
What I leave.
What I'm willing to survive—

I decide.

Bridge

I used to think confidence
meant never being scared.

I was wrong.

Confidence is hearing “no”

and refusing
to turn it into your name.

It's losing the room

without losing yourself.

It's walking away from any love
that asks you to disappear.

If my voice shakes—

let it shake.

If my knees shake—

let them shake.

I can be terrified
and still take one more step.

I can be soft
and still be powerful.

I can fall
and still get up.

And I do not need
to become less

to be loved by anyone.

So no—

I am not too loud.

I am not too much.

I am not too ambitious.

I am not too late.

I am done measuring my life
with somebody else's tape.

Final Chorus

WHO TELLS ME WHO I'M GONNA BE?

I DECIDE!

WHO TELLS ME HOW HIGH I CAN REACH?

I DECIDE!

I won't make myself smaller.

I won't stand politely outside.

If the door has got my name on it—

I'M WALKING THROUGH TONIGHT.

What I want.

What I'm worth.

What I do with this one life—

I DECIDE.

But if you're standing at a doorway
with that same fear in your eyes,

put your hand upon the handle.

You don't need to ask them twice.

Come beside me.

Bring your courage.

Bring the dream you kept inside.

This was never only my door.

WE DECIDE.

Final Lift

WE DECIDE!

How we rise.

WE DECIDE!

How we live.

WE DECIDE!

What we're worth
and what we'll never again give up to fit.

No permission.

No apology.

No more waiting outside.

Every woman coming after us—

WE HOLD THE DOOR OPEN WIDE.

Outro

They taught me to knock softly
on doors with my name on them.

Funny.

I don't knock anymore.

I walk through.

And when I see another woman
waiting where I used to wait—

I hold the door.

Because my power isn't only
choosing my own life.

It's making sure she knows

she can choose hers.

I decide.

We decide.

title: I’d Choose It Again
lyrics:
Female version

Verse 1

The doctor left the room this morning,

Funny how a woman sees things clearly
when she knows there’s not much more.

I can hear the clock beside me.
I can feel the evening close.
But I’m not asking time for mercy.

I’ve had more life than most will know.

They said, “Slow down, you’re crazy.”
They said, “Girl, you’ll lose it all.”
Maybe I was born believing
there was something past the wall.

Pre-Chorus

I took roads they called impossible.
I knocked on doors marked “No.”
Sometimes I found a paradise.

Sometimes I found out why they wrote it so.

Chorus

Call me crazy.
Call me stupid.
Call me anything you please.

Call me a fool for chasing freedom
when I could have lived with ease.

I have scars I wouldn’t ask for.
I have nights I’d change somehow.

But if you gave me back the years
and let me choose them now—

I’d take the love.
I’d take the pain.
I’d take the sun.
I’d take the rain.

Knowing where the road would end,

I’d choose it all again.

Verse 2

I loved some people badly.
I let some good ones walk away.
There were words I should have swallowed
and some I should have found the strength to say.

I was told to be more careful,
not to want so much from life.
To be grateful, quiet, sensible,
to fit inside somebody else’s lines.

But I wanted all the colours.
I wanted every open door.
And every time they said, “Be reasonable,”

I heard something in me asking for more.

Pre-Chorus 2

Yes, regret has sat beside me.
Yes, I’ve paid for what I’ve done.

But every wrong turn left me somewhere.

Every darkness taught me sun.

Chorus

Call me crazy.
Call me stupid.
Call me anything you please.

Call me a fool for choosing freedom
over living on my knees.

I have scars I wouldn’t ask for.
I have tears I’d still allow.

Because the woman lying here tonight
is the woman those choices made somehow.

I’d take the love.
I’d take the pain.
I’d lose my heart
and love again.

Knowing every broken end,

I’d choose it all again.

Bridge

Come closer.

There’s one thing I need you to know.

Don’t spend your whole life becoming
what everybody says you owe.

They called me crazy
when I walked away from what was killing me.

They called me stupid
when I trusted what I couldn’t prove.

They called me foolish
every time I loved with everything I had.

Funny—

those were the moments
that made this life worth losing.

So yes—

I have regrets.

Of course I do.

I regret the hands I didn’t hold.
The apologies I made too late.
The days I traded for tomorrow
when tomorrow could have waited.

I regret the times I made myself smaller
just to make somebody stay.

But I do not regret becoming
the woman I fought to be today.

And if there’s one thing death has taught me:

a life can be imperfect
and still be a masterpiece.

Final Chorus

So call me crazy!
I was crazy enough to dream.

Call me stupid!
I believed in things unseen.

Call me a fool!
I loved when love could leave.

And if that makes me foolish—

what a blessed fool I’ve been.

I took the laughter.
I took the blame.
I took the glory.
I took the shame.

I broke.
I healed.
I lost.
I changed.

And I would do it all the same.

Not because I got it perfect.

Not because I always won.

But because when my time is over,

I will know
I truly lived one.

Give me every road behind me.
Give me every scar and friend.

Give me every beautiful mistake—

I’d choose it all again.

Outro

The room is getting quieter now.

The evening’s almost through.

And for once
I don’t need another tomorrow.

I had today.

I had yesterday.

I had love.

I had a life

And if somewhere there’s a question

[Intro — Instantly recognisable four-note saxophone hook]

title: One Gave You Go
lyrics:
[Intro - bare stomp-clap, one crunchy guitar riff]
[Verse 1 - lean, gritty, conversational]
Nine miles on a bike that's older than me
Five good strings on a six-string guitar
Ninety-nine doors, not one swung open
Forty pages of songs, and nobody thinks I'll get far
[Pre-Chorus - rising toms, building]
Dad says, "Son, get a real job"
Mom just turns the TV loud
The ones who should be clappin'
Are the quietest in the crowd
Posted one song at two a.m.
One stranger typed, "Keep going, I'm right here"
[Chorus - wide, twin guitars, gang vocals]
Ninety-nine gave you NO!
(NO!)
One stranger gave you GO!
(GO!)
Nobody's gonna hand you the light
Turn it up and take the night
(One, two, three, GO!)
[Verse 2 - tighter, more urgent]
Four times I made the stage, three times I turned around
Two hands shakin', one voice sayin', "They'll laugh you out of town"
Bike got stolen once, luck ain't been kind
But the worst of it all was in my mind
[Pre-Chorus 2 - higher lift]
Uncle wrote "get a job" in the comments
Forty strangers wrote "don't you dare"
Somewhere in Brazil, somewhere in Belfast
Somebody's singin' it out there
[Chorus 2 - bigger, more gang vocals]
Ninety-nine gave you NO!
(NO!)
And one was in your head
Forty strangers gave you GO!
(GO!)
Nobody's gonna hand you the light
Turn it up and take the night
(One, two, three, GO!)
[Bridge - drums drop, voice and one guitar only, raw and exposed]
Ninety-nine nights I waited on a yes
From a house that never knew how
And that voice in my head that whispers "quit"
Has my father's voice, somehow
[Spoken - quiet]
One hour. One page. One step.
Scared? Fine. Go scared.
[Whispered crowd count-in]
One... two... three...
[Final Chorus - full band explosion, thousand-voice gang vocals, high harmony, key lift]
Ninety-nine gave you NO!
(NO!)
You beat the one in your head!
A THOUSAND gave you GO!
(GO!)
Nobody's gonna hand you the light
Turn it up and take the night
[Tag - crowd chant, biggest moment]
So if you're on a bike with five good strings
And nobody home believes a thing
Somebody out there hears you sing
(One, two, three, GO!)
[Outro - one lone guitar, five strings, sparse]
Page forty-one.
Ninety-nine gave you no...
One gave you go.
[End]

title: One More Ordinary Night
lyrics:
Verse 1
You never let the kitchen light go dark.
"Somebody might come home," you'd say.
I'd click it off on my way up the stairs,
You'd tiptoe down and click it back anyway.
Pre-Chorus
I thought the good part was up ahead.
I thought there'd be a thousand more like this.
Chorus
Give me one more ordinary night,
Nothing special, nothing planned,
Your cold feet on my knees on the couch,
Some old show, your hand in my hand.
I'd give back every big day we had
For one more ordinary night.
Verse 2
Now I eat standing up at the counter.
Your mug's still up on its shelf.
Our daughter says, "Dad, it's okay to move it."
I say, "I know," and I put it back myself.
Pre-Chorus 2
Nobody tells you which night's the last one.
Nobody rings a bell.
Chorus 2
Give me one more ordinary night,
Nothing special, nothing planned,
Just the sound of you humming, drying a dish,
Some old show, your hand in my hand.
I'd give back every big day we had
For one more ordinary night.
Bridge (stripped, near-spoken)
Thirty-one years I clicked that light off.
Thirty-one years you clicked it back on.
I never asked who "somebody" was.
It was me. It was always me.
Final Chorus
Give me one more ordinary night,
Nothing special, nothing planned.
I'd walk right past the kitchen light,
And I'd know it while I held your hand.
I'd give back every big day we had.
I didn't know that was the best of it.
Give me one more ordinary night.
Outro (spoken)
So I leave the kitchen light on.
Somebody might come home.

title: Quantum Heart
lyrics:
[Intro]
Hola…
Bonjour…
Ciao…
Namaste…
Ni hao…
Salaam…
One heart…
[Verse 1]
Sotto le stelle, caminamos juntos,
dans la nuit, on cherche la lumière,
bajo el cielo, seguimos soñando,
wir sind hier — wir sind nicht allein.
Kokoro wa odoru,
saranghae, je t'aime,
duniya ek hai,
we feel the same.
[Pre-Chorus]
Different names, different roads,
different stories that nobody knows.
Pero siente, écoute, regarde-moi —
we're alive, we're alive.
[Chorus]
Quantum Heart!
Quantum Heart!
One beat — one beat!
Quantum Heart!
Quantum Heart!
You and me — we meet!
Amor! Liebe! Love!
Amour! 愛! Amor!
Different words — same feeling,
one heart!
Quantum Heart!
Quantum Heart!
One world — one heart!
[Verse 2]
Aunque duela, seguimos adelante,
même dans l'ombre, on garde l'espoir,
anche se cadiamo, ci rialziamo,
どんな時も — we carry on.
Tú lloras, yo lloro,
tu rêves, je rêve,
너와 나 — 하나,
you and I — the same.
[Bridge]
Somos humanos.
Nous sommes humains.
Wir sind Menschen.
Siamo umani.
私たちは人間です.
우리는 인간이에요.
One breath.
One beat.
One heart.
[Final Chorus]
Quantum Heart!
Quantum Heart!
One beat — one beat!
Quantum Heart!
Quantum Heart!
You and me — we meet!
Amor! Liebe! Love!
Amour! 愛! Amor!
Different words — same feeling,
ONE HEART!
Quantum Heart!

title: Rain Check
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Spoken, whispered, drawled, over rain]
Sorry, y'all, I'm busy.
(beat)
Chapter nineteen.
[Verse 1]
Group chat lights up: "Storm's coming, rain check?"
I type "so sad," grinnin' ear to ear
Sweatpants on, hair in a knot, no mirror
Black coffee steamin', and the thunder's finally here
He's got a secret and she's got a grudge
They've hated each other since chapter nine
Tin roof drummin', thunder on my side
And the whole night is mine
[Pre-Chorus]
Page one one two, and somebody lied
Every sentence tightens the wire
Lightning cracks like it read ahead
I'm one page from the fire
[Chorus]
Rain check, rain check
Got somewhere better to be
Page one three eight, cup number three
One more chapter, I've said that nine times
Rain check, rain check
Tell 'em I'm busy, tell 'em I'm fine
I'm in a castle, I'm in a crime
One more chapter, one more time
[Verse 2]
Yellow tabs on every almost-kiss
Pencil in the margin: "FINALLY"
I named the killer back in chapter three
No one to tell, so I tell my coffee
[Pre-Chorus]
Page two four zero, the lamp flickers low
The one she trusted was holdin' the knife
I say "I KNEW IT" to an empty room
And it's the best night of my life
[Chorus]
Rain check, rain check
Got somewhere better to be
Page two six zero, cup number five
One more chapter, I've said that twelve times
Rain check, rain check
Tell 'em I'm busy, tell 'em I'm fine
I'm in a castle, I'm in a crime
One more chapter, one more time
[Bridge]
[Stripped down, bass and bare voice, thunder]
Thunder cracks and the whole town goes dark
Group chat: "Power's out! You okay?"
Book light on, quilt up to my chin
I've never been so far away
[Spoken]
I type back: "Stay home. I'm great."
Nobody's comin'. Best ending yet.
[Final Chorus]
[Biggest chorus, full band, high harmony]
Rain check, rain check
I'm cashin' it in, this whole night's mine
I was in a castle, I was in a crime
Now the lights are out and I've got all the time
Rain check, rain check
Let it thunder, let it pour
One more chapter, then one more
[Outro]
[Spoken, near-whisper, lone guitar riff and fading rain]
Page two six one.
Storm's still goin'.
So am I.

title: Red Lipstick, Cowgirl Hat
lyrics:
Baby, put that cowgirl hat on
Red lipstick, hair falling down
I'll lock the door, dim the hallway light
Come turn this whole night around
[VERSE 1]
You slip your coat off by the doorway
I hang it underneath the light
Your boots come off beside the chair
And you walk back into my sight
You reach for that old cowgirl hat
Tip the brim and give me that smile
Red lipstick against the leather
Girl, you stop my heart a while
I pour the whiskey, you take one sip
Leave a red kiss on my glass
You lean into me, I pull you close
And hope this moment lasts
[PRE-CHORUS]
I had plans to behave tonight
Then you walked in looking like that
Now every time you tip that brim
Girl, you're taking me right off track
[CHORUS]
Red lipstick, cowgirl hat
Girl, you got me wanting more of that
Tip that brim, give me that smile
Come a little closer, stay a little while
Red lipstick, cowgirl hat
Girl, you got me wanting more of that
Red on my glass, red on my neck
One little kiss and I ain't recovered yet
Cowgirl hat...
Red lipstick...
Come closer...
Just like that
[VERSE 2]
You take my hand across the room
Bare feet whisper on the floor
Moonlight slips between the blinds
While I pull you a little closer
Your perfume's caught inside my shirt
Your lipstick leaves another trace
You laugh when I catch you staring
Then hide that smile against my face
The hat falls softly by the bed
You pick it up and put it back
Then tip that little brim at me
Like you know exactly what that does
[PRE-CHORUS]
I was gonna take my time
Let the night unfold real slow
Then you whispered my name
And told me where you wanted me to go
[CHORUS]
Red lipstick, cowgirl hat
Girl, you got me wanting more of that
Tip that brim, give me that smile
Come a little closer, stay a little while
Red lipstick, cowgirl hat
Girl, you got me wanting more of that
Red on my glass, red on my neck
One little kiss and I ain't recovered yet
[BRIDGE]
No phones, no clocks
No world outside
Just your hand in mine
And that look in your eyes
Let the whiskey melt the hours
Let the moonlight take its time
I'll kiss your forehead slowly
Then pull you close to mine
You don't have to say a thing
I can feel you in the silence
Tonight I wanna make you feel
Like the only woman alive
[FINAL CHORUS]
Red lipstick, cowgirl hat
Girl, you got me wanting more of that
Tip that brim, give me that smile
Come a little closer, stay a little while
Red lipstick, cowgirl hat
Girl, you got me wanting more of that
Your lipstick on my neck
Your heartbeat next to mine
Lock that door, baby
Let's lose track of time
Cowgirl hat...
Red lipstick...
Come closer...
Just like that.

title: Right Perfume, Wrong Woman
lyrics:
Verse 1 (country swing, with a wink)
Bartender saw me coming, poured it slow,
Said, "Son, you know where this one goes."
I said, "Sure do," and I left him a twenty,
Fixing my collar, following my nose.
Pre-Chorus
Eyes that say stay, lips that say maybe,
And a phone that lights up at one a.m.
Chorus (snaps to driving pop-rock)
Right perfume, wrong woman,
Jasmine, smoke, and a bad idea in heels.
Every sign says "Turn around,"
I turn the radio up and spin the wheels.
I know better, still I'm going,
Right perfume, wrong woman.
Verse 2
She's got me saved as "Maybe" in her phone,
Right below the pilot, right above the plumber.
I've been waiting on a call since June,
And it's the coldest, longest summer.
Pre-Chorus 2
She says "Come over," means it for an hour,
Says "Go home," and means that too.
Chorus 2
Right perfume, wrong woman,
Jasmine, smoke, and a bad idea in heels.
Every friend I've got says "Turn around,"
I say, "I hear you," and I spin the wheels.
I know better, still I'm going,
Right perfume, wrong woman.
Bridge (drops to bass, pedal steel and a hushed voice)
She never lied. She said it plain:
"I'm not the staying kind."
I heard a dare, I heard a game,
I heard what I went looking to find.
So I rolled the window down
And let the night take her off my collar.
Final Chorus (key change up a whole step)
Right perfume, wrong woman,
Jasmine, smoke, and a bad idea in heels.
Every sign says "Turn around,"
So I turn the radio down, and I turn the wheel.
I know better — and I'm going home.
Right perfume, wrong woman.
Outro (spoken, then one horn stab)
Right perfume…
Wrong woman.
Lord, that was a perfume.

title: Run Around, Getting Nowhere
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
Up in the morning
Tea in my hand
Phone starts ringing
Before I make a plan
Keys by the door
I miss the bus
Check my phone
Then check it again
Everybody needs something
Everybody wants my time
I keep saying, “After this”
Like after this, I’ll find my life
[PRE-CHORUS]
I’m always on my way
Always chasing time
Looking for tomorrow
While today passes me by
[CHORUS]
I run around, run around, getting nowhere
Run around, run around, getting nowhere
I’m always moving
But I’m still right here
Run around, run around, getting nowhere
Everybody’s running
So I run with everyone
Chasing what comes next
Before the last thing’s done
I run around, run around, getting nowhere
[POST-CHORUS]
Round and round
Round and round
Everybody’s going somewhere
Where am I going now?
[VERSE 2]
I see her picture
Somewhere in the sun
New dress, new car
Looks like she’s having fun
I say, “Good for her”
Then put my phone away
Why does somebody else’s life
Make me question mine today?
New year, new me
Another list, another plan
I’ve been so busy getting ready
I forgot to live while I can
[BRIDGE]
Maybe I can miss a call
Maybe I can say, “Not tonight”
Leave the dishes where they are
Watch the last light
I’ve spent so long keeping up
I forgot what I was chasing
I FORGOT WHAT I WAS CHASING
[VOCAL BREAK]
Where am I trying to go?
WHEN DO I GET TO LIVE?
[FINAL CHORUS]
I ran around, ran around, getting nowhere
Ran around, ran around, getting nowhere
I was always moving
But I was standing still
Everybody’s running
But I don’t have to
[OUTRO]
Round and round
Round and round
I don’t wanna run anymore
I never asked myself
Where I wanted to go.
So I’m stopping here.

title: Second To Montana
lyrics:
Verse 1
I thought that Georgia summer
Might finally make you stay
You learned to love the red clay roads
And sweet tea on the porch all day
You said you liked the warm rain
The dogwoods blooming white
I almost thought I'd won you
Till she walked in Friday night
She had those mountain-blue eyes
Boots worn down at the heel
And when she started talking
I saw something in you heal
Chorus
I was always gonna come
Second to Montana
I can see it in the way
You look at her
I could give you Georgia sunsets
Every night forever
But I can't give you back
The boy you were
She feels like open highway
She sounds like going home
And I can't hold a man
Whose heart already knows
So pour another bourbon
Leave the bottle where I am
I was always gonna come
Second to Montana
Verse 2
You kept an old road atlas
Folded underneath the seat
A faded little circle
Where the mountains meet the wheat
You'd talk about those winters
Like the cold could keep you warm
Your daddy's beat-up pickup
That old barn behind the farm
I should've heard the warning
Every time you said "back home"
You weren't talking about a place
You were telling me
Where you belonged
Chorus
I was always gonna come
Second to Montana
I can see it in the way
You look at her
I could give you Georgia sunsets
Every night forever
But I can't give you back
The boy you were
She feels like open highway
She sounds like going home
And I can't hold a man
Whose heart already knows
So pour another bourbon
Leave the bottle where I am
I was always gonna come
Second to Montana
Bridge
Maybe if I'd met you
Before that western sky
Before those mountain mornings
Got written in your eyes
Maybe you could've loved me
Without looking toward the door
But you can't make someone homesick
For somewhere they've never been before
And I can't hate her for reminding you
Of everything you miss
Some women steal a man away
Some women just remind him
Who he is
Final Chorus
I was always gonna come
Second to Montana
Now I know it wasn't something
I could change
I could give you every good thing
I had in Georgia
And you'd still hear those mountains
Call your name
She feels like open highway
She sounds like going home
And tonight you're dancing with her
Like you've finally made it home
So I'll finish up this bourbon
While you take her by the hand
I was always gonna come
Second to Montana
Yeah, I loved you all I could
But I was never gonna beat
Montana
Outro
There's warm rain falling in Georgia
And snow somewhere out west
I hope she gives you everything
I couldn't give you here
I'll leave your side of the bed cold tonight
And your old atlas where it stands
I was good enough to love you
Just never more than
Montana

title: Sirius Bound
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Stole a red kangaroo at midnight
From a road where the dust never sleeps
She rode shotgun under the dashboard
With a look that said, you’re in too deep
Had a rocket parked behind the hangar
Had a bad idea dressed up as a plan
I turned my back for half a heartbeat—
She had both paws on the command
PRE-CHORUS
Warning lights went white
Engines bit the ground
I yelled, “Get out of that seat!”
She kicked the throttle down
CHORUS
Sirius bound — no turning now
Blue fire burning through the black somehow
I stole a kangaroo
She stole the whole damn sky
Now Earth is getting smaller
And that blue star’s getting bright
Sirius bound — hold on tight
She’s got the wheel
And I’ve got one more night
If we’re gonna crash forever
Then we’re crashing into light
VERSE 2
She learned navigation in a minute
Chewed the manual clean in half
Hit the boosters with her left foot
Then looked at me like she could laugh
Mars went bleeding past the window
Jupiter rolled like a loaded gun
Every alarm screamed, “Turn around!”
She just leaned into the sun
PRE-CHORUS
I pulled the kill switch back
She slammed it forward twice
I said, “You’ll get us killed!”
She stared at Sirius like—
That’s the price.
CHORUS
Sirius bound — no turning now
Blue fire burning through the black somehow
I stole a kangaroo
She stole the whole damn sky
Now Earth is just a memory
And that blue star fills my eyes
Sirius bound — hold on tight
She’s got the wheel
And I’ve got one more night
If we’re gonna crash forever
Then we’re crashing into light
INSTRUMENTAL BREAK
(Electric guitar launches the main riff.)
(Violins answer it higher.)
(Drums hammer forward.)
(Everything suddenly drops out.)
BRIDGE
I stole you from the red dirt
You stole me from the world
Maybe neither one of us
Was ever meant to stay
The hull is shaking harder
The blue is everywhere
You look at me—
I look at you—
And neither one looks scared
So hit it.
FINAL CHORUS
SIRIUS BOUND — BURN IT DOWN
Let the engines shake the heavens
Let the stars hear that sound
I stole a kangaroo
She stole the whole damn sky
Now we’re falling through the blue
Like we were born to learn to fly
Sirius bound — hold on tight
No brakes left
No Earth left
Nothing left but light
If the universe wants answers
It can meet us when we land
She’s got one paw on the throttle—
I’ve got both hands in the air
OUTRO
Blue star in the windshield
Fire underneath
I yell, “You crazy bastard—”
She looks back at me
And jumps.
Sirius bound.

title: Somebody Is Us
lyrics:
Verse 1

On a wall beside the station,
a child had drawn the sun,
above a hundred different faces
with their hands joined into one.

I stood there with a crowd of strangers,
all saying, “Someone ought to try
to make the real world look that hopeful.”
Then I heard the words I’d said inside.

Pre-Chorus

We keep waiting for the fearless,
for some hero to appear.
But tomorrow isn't somewhere else—
tomorrow starts right here.

Chorus

Somebody is us.
The hands, the hearts, the hope we're waiting for.
Somebody is us.
Love doesn't live behind another door.

If we dream of something better,
we can't leave it up to luck.
We keep waiting on somebody—

Somebody is us.

Verse 2

A tired Man beneath an awning
saw a stranger in the cold,
took the only coat he carried
and put it round his shoulders.

No bells rang out above them.
No one carved his name in stone.
But for one small human moment,
someone knew they weren't alone.

Pre-Chorus 2

Maybe changing all creation
is too much for one to do.
But the world becomes a little more
like whatever passes through you.

Chorus

Somebody is us.
The hands, the hearts, the hope we're waiting for.
Somebody is us.
Love doesn't live behind another door.

If we dream of something better,
we can't leave it up to luck.
We keep waiting on somebody—

Somebody is us.

Bridge

I used to ask for someone braver,
someone stronger than I am.
Someone born to move the mountains,
someone with a greater plan.

Then one morning in the mirror
there was nowhere left to run.
And I finally heard the question:

“What if you're the someone?”

Time won't keep our good intentions
if they never leave our mouths.
History remembers footsteps,
not the fingers of the crowd.

And love is more than wishing.
Love is choosing. Love is done.
No single Man can heal the whole world—

but the healing starts with one.

Breakdown

One hand.

One heart.

One voice saying,
“I'll begin.”

Then another.

Then another.

Till the stranger becomes kin.

Final Chorus

SOMEBODY IS US!

The hands, the hearts,
the hope we've waited for.

SOMEBODY IS US!

We don't leave love
outside another door.

If we dream of something better,
then the dreaming isn't enough.

No more waiting on somebody—

SOMEBODY IS US.

Let the hungry find a table.
Let the frightened find a friend.
Let forgiveness break the circle
someone thought would never end.

Let every child inherit
more than what was handed us.

If somebody must build a better world—

SOMEBODY IS US.

Gospel Refrain

Somebody is us.
(We are the ones.)

Somebody is us.
(Let the love come.)

One heart can wake another heart,
one light can wake another light.

Till millions who were waiting
stand together and decide—

Somebody is us.

The job I'd nearly given up.

Your name was underneath my thumb.
You answered, "Honey, how'd it go?"

Tonight I can't make up my mind.
[Chorus]
There's still a first time
For a feeling this new.
I've held somebody's hand before,
But never walked with you.
Let the years show on our faces,
Let the porch light catch the grey.
There's still a first time.
You make me feel that way.
[Verse 2]
An old song finds us on the radio.
You reach to turn it high.
You sing a verse I've never heard,
I take the chorus twice.
You say, "We ought to know it better."
I hope we get it wrong forever.
[Chorus]
There's still a first time
For a feeling this new.
I've held somebody's hand before,
But never walked with you.
Let the years show on our faces,
Let the porch light catch the grey.
There's still a first time.
You make me feel that way.

For a feeling this new.

But never walked with you.
Let the years show on our faces,

title: Take Me Back To May 18Th, 1838
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I fell out of thunder in a field before dawn
Blood on my knuckles, the century gone
No money, no mercy, no name I could use
Just a coat full of rain and a lifetime of bruises
I'd been every bad thing a frightened man could be
Every soul I ever loved had given up on me
Then she found me half-dead by a split-rail gate
Friday, May eighteenth, eighteen thirty-eight
[Pre-Chorus]
She never asked me to be good
She just gave me reasons to try
And for the first time in forever
I was afraid to say goodbye
[Chorus]
Take me back to May eighteenth, eighteen thirty-eight
To the lamp in her window and the split-rail gate
To the woman who looked at the worst of me
And still made room for who I could be
I had nothing but scars
I had nothing but rage
She taught these two hands
They could build, not break
If time has one mercy
For a soul like mine
Take me back to May eighteenth
Eighteen thirty-eight
[Verse 2]
She never asked what I'd done
She asked, “Have you eaten?”
Put bread in my hands
Like I still had a reason
By June I was mending her fence in the heat
By July I could finally sleep through the night
By August we were dancing by the fire after dark
Her head on my chest, her hand on my heart
By September I knew I had something to lose
Something worth staying for
Something to choose
She kissed every scar I was trying to hide
And somehow the monster got quieter inside
[Pre-Chorus]
I told her, “There are things I've done
No good man could forgive”
She said, “I ain't asking who you were
I'm asking how you'll live”
[Chorus]
Take me back to May eighteenth, eighteen thirty-eight
To the lamp in her window and the split-rail gate
To the woman who knew every darkness in me
And loved me toward the man I wanted to be
I had nothing but scars
I had nothing but rage
She taught these two hands
They could build, not break
If time has one mercy
For a soul like mine
Take me back to May eighteenth
Eighteen thirty-eight
[Bridge]
Then Wednesday, October third
Eighteen thirty-eight
The wind went dead quiet
By the split-rail gate
The sky cracked blue
Like the night I arrived
And I knew in one heartbeat
Time had come to collect
I grabbed both her hands
Said, “I don't want to go”
She held on tighter
Said, “Then remember what you know”
I said, “You're the first thing
I ever got right”
She screamed my name
And the whole world went white
[Final Chorus]
Take me back to May eighteenth, eighteen thirty-eight
Let me fall from that thunder by her split-rail gate
Let me come with my anger
My scars and my shame
I'd carry them all again
Just to hear her say my name
Let me mend every fence
Let me learn how to stay
Let her teach these two hands
They can build, not break
I don't want forever
I don't need all of time
Just give me that woman
And one mortal life
Take every tomorrow
Take every yesterday
Just take me back
Take me back
Take me back to May
May eighteenth
Eighteen thirty-eight
[Outro]
Now whatever year they throw me in
Whatever world I face
I still see that lamp burning
I still see her face
They can send me through forever
They can curse me every way
But every clock I hear now
Runs backward
To May

title: Take Your Time
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You put your coat on halfway through
A story I was telling you.
You said you ought to catch your train,
Then sat back down to hear the end.

You need another night.

You can take your time with me,
Let the evening be an evening.
You don't have to call it love

If tonight is all you've got,
Tonight is plenty for a while.
You can take your time,
You can take your time.

title: That Look on You
lyrics:

The one you're giving me.
Like you've got something on your mind
You're almost letting me see.
We can let this old song finish,
We can dance another two.
I ain't watching anybody else.
I like that look on you.
[Verse 2]
You said, "It's been so long since someone

You pulled me closer anyway.
[Chorus]
I like that look on you,
The one you're giving me.
Like you've got something on your mind
You're almost letting me see.
We can let this old song finish,
We can dance another two.
I ain't watching anybody else.
I like that look on you.

Now you've got nothing left to hide

I've got nowhere else to be.
I like that look on you
When you're looking back at me.

Your hand stays warm inside of mine.
We take our time with saying goodnight.

lyrics:

lyrics:

title: The Other Road
lyrics:

“Same rain, same road, same minute

title: The Thing That Kept Me Here
lyrics:

Doesn't have to keep me here tonight

Same glass
Same light
