[Verse 2]
The better I got, the harder it got
To even say hello without tying a knot
In my chest, ‘cause I already saw the end
Before the first date could even begin
I’d picture her leaving before she arrived
So I stayed home and just survived
Talked myself out of every chance
Lived in a loop I couldn’t dance
[Pre-Chorus]
Everybody said time would heal
But time just made the fear more real
Told myself I wasn’t worth the shot
So I never gave love another thought
[Chorus]
This is what’s left of me
Broke and a little bit empty
Ain’t got much money, ain’t got many friends
Got a whole lot of baggage and failed old plans
I’m the worst version of the man I was
But I’m still standing here with a little hope and trust
If you’re looking for perfect, you won’t find him here
But what’s left of me is still trying, my dear
[Bridge]
I’m done with the silence, done with the fear
Done with pretending I don’t want you near
I know I’m a mess, I know I’m a risk
But I’m done letting the past keep its fist
On my throat, so I’m walking out that door
With nothing but honesty and a little more
Hope than I had when I started this fight
I’m offering all of the worst of me tonight
[Final Chorus]
This is what’s left of me
Broke and a little bit empty
Ain’t got much money, ain’t got many friends
Got a whole lot of baggage and failed old plans
I’m the worst version of the man I was
But I’m still standing here with a little hope and trust
If you’re looking for perfect, you won’t find him here
But what’s left of me is still trying, my dear
Yeah, what’s left of me is still trying
Still trying, my dear
[Outro]
(soft)
What’s left of me…
Is still hoping.

title: When I Say Seven
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You ask if we're still on tonight,
Then say, "It's fine if something's changed."
I hear you trying to sound light,
Like you weren't looking forward to it.
You've spent too many nights dressed up
For someone who forgot to come.
[Chorus]
When I say seven,
I'll be pulling in your drive.
You won't have to spend the evening
Reading reasons into headlights.
Let me earn it little by little,
Every word and every day.
When I say seven,
That's a promise I can make.
[Verse 2]
Last Friday, work kept you till nine.
You called, prepared to take the blame.
I said, "There's no need to apologise.
We'll find ourselves another day."
You went quiet on the other end,
Then asked if we could try again.
[Chorus]
When I say seven,
I'll be pulling in your drive.
You won't have to spend the evening
Reading reasons into headlights.
Let me earn it little by little,
Every word and every day.
When I say seven,
That's a promise I can make.
[Bridge]
If I'm running late, I'll call you
Before you start to wonder why.
I can't promise life runs easy.
I can keep you on my mind.
[Final Chorus]
When I say seven,
I'll be pulling in your drive.
You won't have to spend the evening
Reading reasons into headlights.
Let me earn it little by little,
Every word and every day.
When I say seven,
That's a promise I can make.
[Outro]
Tonight you're waiting on the porch,
Smiling before I reach the door.

title: While It Was Here
lyrics:
Verse 1
There’s a coffee ring still on the table
From the morning you turned twenty-nine
You were barefoot, dancing in the kitchen
I was running late and checking time
You said, “Baby, stay another minute”
I kissed your cheek and grabbed my keys
Funny how the things we barely notice
Become the things we’d give anything to see
Pre-Chorus
We kept waiting on the good days
Like the good days weren’t already there
Chorus
We had heaven while it was here
In a two-room house and a secondhand year
In the bills, the babies, the laughter, the tears
We had heaven while it was here
I thought someday was somewhere down the road
Some bigger life, some pot of gold
God, I wish I knew what I know from here—
We had heaven
Verse 2
There’s a pencil mark beside the doorway
Where we measured every growing year
Your old coat’s hanging where you left it
I still haven’t moved it from the chair
We spent half our lives saying “when things settle”
Then the kids grew up and moved away
And the house got everything we asked for
Except one more ordinary day
Pre-Chorus
Now I’d trade every tomorrow
For one Tuesday back with you
Chorus
We had heaven while it was here
In your tired blue eyes and my cheap cold beer
In slammed doors, slow dances, forgiveness and years
We had heaven while it was here
I thought someday was somewhere down the road
Some bigger life, some pot of gold
God, I wish I knew what I know from here—
We had heaven
Bridge
If I could go back, I wouldn’t change us
I’d just notice us a little more
I’d leave my keys right there beside you
And never make it to that door
’Cause a lifetime doesn’t leave all at once
It disappears in little things—
A coffee cup, a hallway light
A kitchen where somebody sings
Final Chorus
We had heaven while it was here
And I finally see it crystal clear
It wasn’t somewhere we were going
It was every day that brought us here
So if you’ve got somebody waiting
Put your hurry down and hold ’em near
Don’t spend your whole life looking for heaven—
You might be standing in it
While it’s here
Outro
The coffee ring is fading on the table
But I can still see you dancing there.

title: While We’re Here
lyrics:
Verse 1
Your coffee's gone cold by the sink again
You're dancing barefoot, late for work
Sun on the floor, one button undone
Still singing the wrong words to the verse
I used to think the big days
Would be the ones I couldn't forget
Now I'm staring at a Tuesday morning
Thinking, don't let me miss this yet
Pre-Chorus
Leave the clock where it is
Don't rush this out the door
Maybe the life we're waiting for
Is already ours
Chorus
While we're here, while we're here
Put your hand in mine
Let the whole world disappear
For a little while
We don't get to keep the hours
We only get to fill them up
If all we ever own is now
Let now be enough
While we're here
Verse 2
There'll be boxes in the hallway
Different keys, a different view
There'll be pictures where we're younger
Than we ever knew we were
One day this table will be silent
One day one of us will know
How a room can hold a lifetime
After someone has to go
Pre-Chorus 2
So say the thing you came to say
Stay five minutes more
Maybe love is knowing nothing stays
And loving anyway
Chorus 2
While we're here, while we're here
Put your hand in mine
Let the whole world disappear
For a little while
We don't get to keep each other
Not the way we wish we could
If all we ever own is now
Then now has to be enough
While we're here
Bridge
And if my last thought
Gets one place to go
Let it come back to this—
Rain against the window
Your hand finding mine
The quiet after your kiss
Not the fireworks
Not the photographs
Not some perfect year
Just you saying my name
Like you mean it
While we're still here
Final Chorus
While we're here, while we're here
Put your hand in mine
Let the whole world disappear
We were never promised time
We don't get to keep the hours
But love keeps what the clocks give up
If all we ever own is now
Then now is more than enough
While we're here
Oh, while we're here
Don't wait for someday
Don't wait for someday
We're already here
Outro
Your coffee's gone cold by the sink again
Mine's going cold there too
Let the morning keep on moving
I'm staying here with you.

title: Who Taught Us Who To Hate
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
She sewed three photographs
Inside the lining of her coat
He carried one old house key
To a street that wasn't there anymore
At the border they were numbers
In the papers they were blame
Years later children stand behind the glass
And ask why no one learned their names
[Pre-Chorus]
We always swear we'd know it
If those days came back again
But cruelty looks ordinary
When everybody calls it sense
[Chorus]
Who taught us who to hate?
Who taught us who to fear?
Who made the word “stranger”
Louder than the heartbeat standing here?
If your home was burning down
And mine was the nearest gate
Would I learn your name
Or only what they taught me to hate?
[Verse 2]
My phone lights up at midnight
Ten thousand voices say the same:
“There’s no time, they’re coming, share this”
Every finger points the blame
But some mouths have never breathed
Some faces never had a past
A borrowed voice can sound like mine
And make a lie feel true that fast
Somebody's feeding a family
Somebody's selling fear
And attention keeps the money moving
As long as I stay here
Good news dies by morning
Bad news travels straight
There's money in my anger
Every time I click on hate
[Pre-Chorus]
Before I share it
Before I choose
Before the fear decides my side
Who gets richer if I hate you?
Who gets stronger if we fight?
[Chorus]
Who taught us who to hate?
Who taught us who to fear?
Who made the word “stranger”
Louder than the heartbeat standing here?
If your home was burning down
And mine was the nearest gate
Would I learn your name
Or only what they taught me to hate?
[Verse 3]
One boy learns a foreign word
And hears it means “the enemy”
Across the line another boy
Is taught the same about somebody
Neither knows the other's mother
Neither knows the other's name
But long before they meet each other
Someone's taught them where to aim
“To be immortal, many must die”
That's the bargain statues hide
One name climbs into history
While a thousand mothers keep the rest alive
Maps remember who took the ground
Books remember dates
But graves don't know who drew the line
Or who they were supposed to hate
[Future Breakdown]
Poster.
Paper.
Radio.
Television.
Screen.
Feed.
One voice became a thousand.
Now a thousand may be none.
A face can look completely human
Without ever seeing the sun
AI learns what keeps me watching
Learns the words that make me stay
AGI could learn my reasons
And answer every doubt I raise
ASI waits beyond the question
If intelligence outruns our own
What happens when the lie knows me
Better than I've known myself?
And while we're fighting in the comments
Another race accelerates
They're racing for quantum
While we're learning who to hate
For the keys behind the codes
For the secrets nations guard
Whoever holds the quantum keys
May move the war before it starts
New machines
Old fears
Different century
Same flame
The tools keep getting smarter
But the wound
Still has a human name
[Bridge]
I've stood where all the slogans end
I've seen what happens when they win
I've done things I cannot take back
I still hear voices when I sleep
There are screams no flag can silence
There are faces medals can't erase
And once you've watched a mother lose her child
You stop believing grief has sides
Pain can become another weapon
Or pain can end with me
If pain is passed from hand to hand
Let mine
Be the final hand
I will not hand my fear to children
I will not teach them who to blame
And if you want me to call someone my enemy
First...
Let me learn their name
[Final Chorus]
Who taught us who to hate?
Then who says we can't unlearn?
No child comes here with enemies
That's something handed down in turn
If your home is burning down
Mine can be the nearest gate
I'll learn your name before I learn
The name they want me to hate
Who taught us who to fear?
Who taught us not to recognise
Ourselves in everybody here?
Your child cries like my child
Your mother grieves like mine
Grief doesn't read a passport
Blood doesn't choose a side
So before they sell us anger
Before they tell us it's too late
Before a stranger becomes an enemy
Learn their name
Learn their name
Learn their name
Before they teach you
Who to hate
[Outro]
One day they'll put our years behind glass
Like all the years before
Children will stare at what we did
And ask what we were frightened for
They'll ask how much we knew
They'll ask why we believed
They'll ask how human beings with so much knowledge
Were still so easy to deceive
I hope they say we saw the pattern
While there was still time to change
I hope they say:
We learned each other's names...
Before we learned
To hate.

title: Worthy Of Love
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You talked about a house with a porch out front
Said my name beside yours like it fit just right
We were picking wedding songs in the kitchen
Then you packed your words and left overnight
I still see your ring hand turning in the sunlight
Still hear forever in the way you said my name
I thought my heart had found its only harbor
Now every room feels changed

[Pre-Chorus]
I’m counting what I don’t have
A broke-down plan and empty hands

[Chorus]
Can a man like me fall in love again?
With no keys in his pocket, no place to begin
No money in the bank, no sure way through
Just a heart that’s scared and still reaching for you
If I’m not somebody’s easy dream
If I’m all rough edges and unfinished things
Tell me, is there a door that opens up above?
Can a man like me be worthy of love?

[Verse 2]
I’ve been taking odd jobs when somebody calls me
Walking home past the fields when the day turns blue
My friends say time will make it feel less heavy
But time can’t tell me what I’m meant to do
I don’t need a shining life to bring you
Just a chance to show the good I’ve got inside
But I keep hearing that old goodbye behind me
Like a warning I can’t set aside

[Pre-Chorus]
I’m learning not to call it truth
Just ’cause one heart changed its mind on me

[Chorus]
Can a man like me fall in love again?
With no keys in his pocket, no place to begin
No money in the bank, no sure way through
Just a heart that’s scared and still reaching for you
If I’m not somebody’s easy dream
If I’m all rough edges and unfinished things
Tell me, is there a door that opens up above?
Can a man like me be worthy of love?

[Bridge]
Maybe love ain’t something you earn with a new truck
Or a polished story and a lucky break
Maybe it’s two tired hands held steady
And the brave first step you’re willing to take
I can’t promise I’ll arrive with everything
But I can show up honest, day by day

[Final Chorus]
Maybe a man like me can fall in love again
Even with empty pockets and a road that bends
I’ve got a little faith, and a heart that’s still true
And room for the kind of love that grows with you
I may not be somebody’s easy dream
But I’m more than the worst thing that happened to me
There’s a door somewhere, and I’m turning toward
Maybe I can be worthy of love
Maybe I can be worthy of love

[Outro]
I thought you were my once-in-a-lifetime
I’m learning life can still begin

title: You Can Take Your Time
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You keep your car keys in your hand,
Say you can't stay too late.
Then ask about the old guitar
Beside the fireplace.
[Pre-Chorus]
You don't have to make your mind up
Just because you're feeling something.
[Chorus]
You can take your time with me,
We can let this be tonight.
You don't have to promise Sunday
On a quiet Friday night.
If you want a little closer,
I'll meet you halfway.
You can take your time with me.
I like you just this way.
[Verse 2]
You called to change our dinner plans,
Said walking sounded good.
We talked until the streetlights blinked
Around the neighbourhood.
[Pre-Chorus]
You reached for me, then drew your hand back.
I kept walking close beside you.
[Chorus]
You can take your time with me,
We can let this be tonight.
You don't have to promise Sunday
On a quiet Friday night.
If you want a little closer,
I'll meet you halfway.
You can take your time with me.
I like you just this way.
[Bridge]
You said, "I used to fall so easy.
I don't know what happened to me."
I said, "I've liked this whole evening."
You laid your car keys down by me.
[Final Chorus]
You can take your time with me,
We can let this be tonight.
You don't have to promise Sunday
On a quiet Friday night.
You moved a little closer;
I met you halfway.
You can take your time with me.
I like you just this way.
[Outro]
That old guitar stayed in the corner.
We talked till yesterday.

title: You Never Have To Wonder
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
I saw those blue eyes through a crowded room,
Long blonde hair catching the afternoon.
Then you said something that made me laugh,
And suddenly I wanted more than that.
Beauty was only the first thing I saw,
Your mind was the reason I stayed for more.
You turn a thought until I see it new,
And every time I learn you, I fall deeper into you.
[PRE-CHORUS]
So when the weight of the world gets heavy,
Come put your heart against mine.
You don't have to be strong with me,
You can let your armor fall this time.
[CHORUS]
You never have to wonder,
You never have to doubt.
When I picture where my life is going,
You're the woman I see there now.
You never have to wonder
Where my heart will be.
If I had every road in this world to choose,
I'd take the one that leads to you and me.
[VERSE 2]
I want your sleepy smile at one thirty-eight,
When the whole world sleeps and we're still awake.
Those midnight talks where we lose track of time,
Your hand finding mine in the dark of the night.
The quiet little things that make this house feel safe,
The smile you try to hide when you're teasing me.
And when the moon hangs low above our window,
We'll howl at the night without making a sound.
[PRE-CHORUS 2]
And if tomorrow asks more of you
Than you think your heart can give,
Just reach for me in the darkness,
I'll remind you how to breathe.
[CHORUS 2]
You never have to wonder,
You never have to doubt.
If the years change everything around us,
They won't change what we're about.
You never have to wonder
Where my heart will be.
If forever keeps opening new doors,
I'll keep walking through them with you and me.
[BRIDGE]
I'd take a thousand arrows
If they were flying straight at you.
I'd stand between you and the darkness
And let every one come through.
If the whole world turned against you,
I'd still be standing by your side.
And if I had one last breath left in me,
I'd spend it telling you, “I'm still yours tonight.”
[BREAK — ALMOST WHISPERED]
Not because I have to.
Not because you asked.
Because out of everyone in this world...
I'd choose you again.
[FINAL CHORUS — FULL POWER]
You never have to wonder,
You never have to doubt.
Not when we're young, not when we're old,
Not when the last light's going out.
You never have to wonder
Who I'd come home to.
After every road, every lifetime, every ending,
I'd still find my way to you.
You never have to wonder.
It's always been you.
The woman I saw in that crowded room,
The woman my whole life led me to.
[OUTRO — INTIMATE]
And when we're old someday,
Still awake at one thirty-eight,
You'll look into these same blue eyes,
And I'll reach for your hand the same.
You never have to wonder.
One thirty-eight.
Still me.
Still you.

title: Your Coat Is On The Chair
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You leave your coat across the chair
Like you expect to find it there
I watch the door when engines pass
And count the minutes, count the cracks
You ask me why I turn away
I learned what promises can weigh

[Pre-Chorus]
I want to reach, I want to run
Both hands are shaking, either one

[Chorus]
I don’t trust anyone to stay
I’ve seen the good ones drift away
But when you say my name so gently
Something in me starts to change
I can’t promise I won’t be afraid
I can only let you close today
Maybe love is learning, slowly
Not to make you prove you’ll stay

[Verse 2]
Your coffee cools beside the sink
You don’t fill every quiet space
You let the morning take its time
And leave your hand beside mine
I’ve made a home of keeping score
You don’t ask what I’m keeping it for

[Pre-Chorus]
I want to reach, I want to run
But now I know which way I’m turning

[Chorus]
I don’t trust anyone to stay
I’ve seen the good ones drift away
But when you say my name so gently
Something in me starts to change
I can’t promise I won’t be afraid
I can only let you close today
Maybe love is learning, slowly
Not to make you prove you’ll stay

[Bridge]
If tomorrow brings a hard goodbye
I’ll still be glad I let tonight be kind
I won’t ask you for forever
Just don’t make me face this alone

[Final Chorus]
I don’t trust anyone to stay
Still, I’m asking you to wait
When you say my name so gently
I can feel the locked door give way
I can’t promise I won’t be afraid
But I can meet you here halfway
Maybe love is learning, slowly
That a heart can choose to stay

[Outro]
Your coat is on the chair again
And I let myself believe it then

title: You’re My Everything
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You still reach for my hand before you wake
Still know when I’m hurting by the face I make
We were young, broke, driving nowhere all night
Your feet on the dash in the radio light
We danced in the rain, drank cheap red wine
Watched the same moon through thousands of different skies
And somewhere between all your laughter and mine
I knew I’d found the love of my life
[Pre-Chorus]
Every road
Every scar
Every dream that fell apart
I’d live it all again
Just to end up where you are
[Chorus]
You’re my everything
So if I go first
Don’t let loving me
Make the rest of your life hurt
Play our old song
Climb that mountain
Look at those stars like we did back then
You’re my everything
But when I’m gone
Be brave enough to love again
[Verse 2]
We counted loose change when the rent ran late
Slammed a few doors, learned how to forgive mistakes
Sat in the driveway when the doctor called
Your hand found mine when the words wouldn’t come at all
We buried our people, watched good dreams disappear
Held each other closer through the hardest years
And every time this life brought us to our knees
You carried me, or I carried you back to our feet
[Pre-Chorus]
Every tear
Every fall
We never faced one alone
That’s what makes this one
The hardest one I’ve known
[Chorus]
You’re my everything
So when I go first
Don’t let my goodbye
Turn your whole world into hurt
Dance in the rain
Pour that red wine
Let yourself laugh like you did back then
You’re my everything
But when I’m gone
Be brave enough to love again
[Bridge]
We survived every storm together
But mine is the one you’ll face alone
And the hardest part of dying
Is knowing I can’t help you carry it home
So don’t love me by staying lonely
Don’t wear your sorrow like a ring
You were the love of my whole life
Don’t let me be the last love you ever see
If another hand finds yours someday
Please don’t pull away for me
The heart I loved was made for loving
Not for living in a memory
[Final Chorus]
You’re my everything
And you always will be
But your forever doesn’t have to end with me
So if love finds you
Open your heart
Don’t let guilt steal one beautiful beat
Play our old song
Climb that mountain
Stand beneath those stars again
And if somebody’s standing beside you
Be brave enough to love again
[Outro]
Same stars
Same moon
Same beautiful view
A different hand
Holding on to you
And if you’re smiling
Under that sky
Then loving you
Was worth goodbye
